lesson.menu_title: Numbers in the KPI Forum -- Thirty Seconds, Three Numbers
lesson.menu_desc: Reportar o KPI do Brasil em trinta segundos, com how much, how many e os quantificadores -- 30 slides
lesson.subtitle: Lesson 5 -- Numbers in the KPI Forum
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Rodrigo Luiz | Lesson 5 -- Numbers in the KPI Forum
lesson.grammar_point: how much / how many + quantifiers (a lot of, a few, a little)

listenings.text: Good morning, everyone. A short note before we start. In this forum every country has thirty seconds. Thirty seconds, no more. Please give us three numbers: how many orders, how many are late, and the average delay. Do not read the full report. We read the report before the call. Thank you.

Hello, everyone. Here is the summary of the month. There are a lot of orders in Europe, and a few problems in Asia. The average delay is three days, and that is one day more than last month. The cost is on target in every country. Brazil is the best country this month, with only three percent late. Congratulations, Brazil.

extra_audio.text: The forum starts at ten in the morning. Every country has thirty seconds. Rodrigo says how many orders Brazil has this month. He says how many orders are late, and the average delay. He sends the full report by Friday.
